title: Number of Elapsed Seconds Between Two Times
summary: Given two valid times in 'HH:MM:SS' format as startTime and endTime, calculate the total number of seconds that have passed between these two times.
statement: Given two valid times in 'HH:MM:SS' format as startTime and endTime, calculate the total number of seconds that have passed between these two times.
constraints: Both inputs are valid same-day times in HH:MM:SS form.
start_time is no later than end_time.
Return the number of elapsed seconds.
hints: Convert each time to seconds since midnight.
Subtract the start value from the end value.
The same-day ordering guarantees a nonnegative result.
editorial: The same-day ordering guarantees a nonnegative result.

tests.explanation: Only twenty-five seconds separate the two times.
The consecutive times differ by one second.
